prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production flat French bulldog puppet atlas, genuine transparent alpha, square 1536x1536, invisible equal 3x3 grid with 512px cells. Image1 is Hooper reference for likeness, coat and RELATIVE PIECE SIZES; image2 is flat vector style target only. Hooper is a stocky brindle French bulldog facing RIGHT. Flat solid dark brown + tan brindle stripes, only two or three tones, identical palette across all pieces. NO painted fur, shading gradients, outlines, texture, glow, flecks, text, logos, checkerboard or grid lines. Clean crisp silhouettes.
EXACT GRID: top-left TORSO; top-middle HEAD WITH NECK AND ORANGE COLLAR; top-right EMPTY transparent. Middle row front upper leg; front lower leg; front paw. Bottom row hind thigh; hind shank; hind paw including hock/foot. Eight parts total.
TORSO IMPORTANT FIX: DO NOT COPY REFERENCE TORSO OUTLINE. Compact horizontal muscular barrel body ONLY, no neck, NO LEGS OR LEG STUMPS, no attached shoulder column or thigh hanging down. Smooth continuous underside: deep at front chest (right), gentle belly line tucked up toward hips (left). Nothing hangs beneath belly line at either end. Rounded shoulder/hip attachment areas contained WITHIN torso silhouette so separate leg tops overlap them. Short tiny tail stub at top of rump (left). Cream chest patch at right front edge. Torso wide horizontally like reference but remove hanging rear thigh and hanging chest leg.
HEAD: preserve reference French bulldog likeness: short flat dark muzzle, broad dark nose, upright bat ears, dark brown/tan brindle shapes, cream throat, orange collar. NO eye detail like flat human puppets. Head and neck one piece, neck tapers at bottom to tuck into torso front. No extra torso on head.
LEGS: match relative scale to reference; do NOT enlarge every piece to fill cell. Every leg one solid shape with rounded caps at joint ends for overlap. Front upper leg wide shoulder top tapering to sturdy elbow. Hind thigh meaty top, rounded knee. Lower legs sturdy not spindly. Front paw rounded foot with hint of toes pointing right. Hind paw includes hock and right-facing rounded foot. Dark brown with matching simple tan brindle stripes. Same cell placement and relative piece sizes as reference. Wide transparent margins and clear separation. No people or additional animals.

Edit ONLY TOP LEFT TORSO of this atlas. Remove the hanging rear-thigh lobe at bottom-left and hanging front-leg lobe at bottom-right. Torso must be a smooth horizontal bean/oval body, NOT a torso-plus-legs silhouette. Raise the rear underside to the tucked waist at back (left), let belly descend gently toward deep chest at right. One uninterrupted smooth underside with no U-shaped notch, no rounded dangling lobes at either end. It is a compact horizontal body ONLY, no legs and no neck. Keep tiny tail on upper-left rump and cream patch on right chest. Keep torso's upper back, length, brindle colors and markings. Preserve other SEVEN pieces exactly, same 3x3 cells with upper-right empty. Keep head/collar and sturdy legs unchanged. Clean flat fills, crisp alpha, no glow texture gradients or shadows.

Re-layout the SAME eight parts on a strict invisible equal 3x3 grid. Do not redesign any part. TOP LEFT torso currently too wide and crosses first-third boundary. Shrink torso UNIFORMLY to 75% current size and center it within top-left cell with transparent margins. TOP MIDDLE head similarly shrink uniformly to 80% and center within top-middle cell. No pixels of torso may cross into head cell; no head pixels may cross into empty top-right cell. Top-right must be fully empty transparent. Keep six leg pieces in middle and bottom rows in their same cells unchanged. Preserve exact flat dog likeness, orange collar, no eyes, brindle stripes, torso with smooth underside NO attached leg stumps. Transparent background, no new lines or text, no grid.
